subject.title: Codex dynamic tools should normalize raw plugin payloads

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Both https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97917 target the same runtime bug, and automation should not queue a third branch or choose between proof-gated candidates without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the broader candidate after proof
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as canonical if its accessible proof and CI state are made reviewable, then close or supersede the sibling candidate.

options.title: Repair the smaller candidate
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97917 only if its serialization finding and real-behavior proof gap are fixed before merge.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until maintainers specify the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Use the broader candidate after proof
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as canonical if its accessible proof and CI state are made reviewable, then close or supersede the sibling candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the most direct recent history in the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and adjacent middleware-output path.
